title: Robert Lovett's memo to Truman leading to the CIA

tellings.quote: It was it was Robert Love it who actually wrote the initial memo to Truman saying we've got to we've got

plain: In the 1940s a Washington official named Robert Lovett is said to have written the first memo to President Harry Truman urging that something like the CIA, the US foreign intelligence agency, be set up. The lawyer and researcher Dan Sheehan says this on the show, without naming where he learned it, and gives little more of the memo than its opening plea that "we've got to" act. He brings it up as part of the agency's beginnings, which would matter for his wider story about secrecy.
